findings.citationQuote: Dedicated liquid and serum formulation lines with dropper- and pump-fill capability. Specializes in Vitamin C and actives-based serums; lists 4 prior serum production programs for regional brands.
findings.reasoning: The document explicitly describes dedicated liquid and serum formulation lines and cites 4 prior serum production programs, providing documented experience with liquid/serum skincare formulations rather than solid or powder cosmetics only.

findings.citationQuote: ISO 22716:2007 (Cosmetics GMP) — Certificate No. IN-COS-22716-1102, issued 2024-09-01, valid until 2027-08-31.
findings.reasoning: A specific certificate record is provided with an identifier (Certificate No. IN-COS-22716-1102), issuance date, and stated validity period, not merely a promotional claim.

No section of the supplier document mentions minimum order quantity (MOQ) or first-order quantity terms. The document covers location, certifications, manufacturing capability, quality history, sustainability, and cost reference, but nothing about order quantities.
The quality history section reports a fail rate of 15% (3 of 20 audited production batches failed), which is the stated historical quality inspection fail rate.
No section of the supplier document states a manufacturing lead time in calendar days or any other time unit. This aspect is not addressed anywhere in the profile.
The title block states the facility location as Pune, Maharashtra, India, exactly as written in the document.
